summary: diet.ts's vegetarian/vegan/pescatarian classifiers had no unresolved-line fallback, so an unresolved 'fish sauce'/'lard'/'nam pla'/'bonito flakes'/'shrimp paste' line below MEANINGFUL_UNRESOLVED_SHARE silently produced likely instead of excluded — the one wrong answer in this feature a person could act on and be harmed by
evidence: reverting diet.ts to the trait-only version and re-running classify.test.ts failed exactly 7 of the new fixtures (see d-d9cf5451): 'Pie crust' with an unresolved lard line went to unknown instead of excluded; a green curry with unresolved fish sauce plus 3 resolved veg lines returned vegetarian=likely; nam pla/bonito flakes/shrimp paste/lardons all returned vegetarian=likely; a generic unresolved 'stock' line also returned likely instead of unknown
